data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): [implicit_assumption] task-2a RED test MUST exercise the production commit-message resolution order used by check-sprint-trailer.sh: in production pre-commit-wrapper.sh invokes the inner hook via bash -c '<cmd>' and does NOT forward git's $1 (the COMMIT_EDITMSG path), so the hook reaches the $GIT_DIR/COMMIT_EDITMSG branch. Add >=1 test case writing the trailer to $GIT_DIR/COMMIT_EDITMSG with NO $1 arg and asserting the hook reads it. A test that only feeds the message via a $1 temp file encodes a false contract (task-2b could pass while broken in production).
